\pneuchapter{I}
\pneuchaptertitle{Arrival by Water}
\begin{pneuchaptersummary}
Ada Quill reaches Low Harbor and learns that her employer is gone.
\end{pneuchaptersummary}

\begin{pneunotes}{7}

\pneunote{1}{Historical}{1}{1}
Tide tables for the period survive; see \pneupageref{10}{p.~10} and \pneupageref{12}{p.~12}.

\pneunote{2}{Comment}{2}{2}
The instrument returns at the end. \textbf{Watch} the brass.

\pneunote{3}{Definition}{1}{3}
\textbf{theodolite} - a surveying instrument for measuring angles

\pneunote{4}{Literary}{1}{4}
\pneufigure{1}{figures/harbor.png}{The harbor at low water}{}

The tin is the first container in the story; see \pneufigureref{1}.

\pneunote{5}{Meditation}{1}{5}
Debt as inheritance—a theme.
\end{pneunotes}
